channel.title: NEWS & LOGS
channel.description: Sakura ARC Official News & Logs. From the latest updates to production philosophy.

item.title: AI is a Goldfish!' Never Trust AI When It Says 'I'll Do It All! | NEWS & LOGS
item.description: Is leaving everything to AI dangerous? A practical survival guide for creators using AI agent environments, explaining context limits and how to prevent project collapse through micro-steps.

item.title: Steam Store Page for Kamiya Detective Agency is Now Open! | NEWS & LOGS
item.description: Sakura ARC is thrilled to announce that the Steam store page (Coming Soon) for our upcoming mystery visual novel, 'Kamiya Detective Agency: High School Girl Vanished in The Summer' is now officially live.

item.title: What Is a "Photoreal Novel"? A Next‑Gen Mystery Blending AI and Real Photography | NEWS & LOGS
item.description: Introducing 'Photoreal Novel,' a new genre proposed by Sakura ARC. We present a new form of immersive visual novel that blends real-world photography with AI-generated visuals.

item.title: Steam 'Kamiya Detective Agency' Coming Soon Page Approved & Multi-Language Support Launched | NEWS & LOGS
item.description: We are thrilled to announce that the Steam Coming Soon page for our upcoming mystery game, 'Kamiya Detective Agency,' has passed platform review. We also introduce the official trailer, website (supporting JA/EN/ZH), and plans for 18-language support.

item.title: AI Agent Updates My Site Faster Than SNS! —— Antigravity × GitHub Pages | NEWS & LOGS
item.description: Why using AI agents makes updating your own site vastly easier than posting on SNS, and how GitHub Pages serves as the ultimate indie deployment architecture.

item.title: Suspense, Memory, and AI. —— Sakura ARC Creative Manifesto | NEWS & LOGS
item.description: Redefining the creative stance in the era of Generative AI. Why an individual with no IT background insists on live-action and logic. On the 1,300+ hour passion for Gnosia, and the clumsy individual's counterattack with AI.
